biotools.summary: teemi is an open-source, literate programming platform for iterative design-build-test-learn cycles in bioengineering, facilitating simulation, organization, and guidance for engineering biosystems. It is designed to enable user-friendly simulation, organization, and guidance for the engineering of biosystems.
